description: List an account's subscriptions; ALWAYS writes the result to the caller-supplied output_tsv_path, never inline. Requires account_id. Zuora's own endpoint (GET /v1/subscriptions/accounts/{account_id}) pages internally at 40 subscriptions per call -- this verb follows that pagination automatically up to the effective row limit. The row limit below is entirely our own policy. Defaults to 500 to avoid exhausting API request limits and disk. To fetch more, pass acknowledge_default_limit_override=true together with an explicit row_limit (up to 5000) -- both are required together, and a row_limit above 5000 is refused rather than silently clamped. Prefer selecting on stable subscription/account IDs downstream over billing-contact PII fields when the goal is validation.
embedding_description: List an account's subscriptions -- current/prior subscriptions and their recurring plans -- to a workspace TSV, up to 5,000 with an acknowledged override, 500 by default, paging past Zuora's own 40-per-call limit. Returns path, columns, row count, and a truncation flag. Review a customer's subscription portfolio and renewal picture; prefer stable ID fields over PII for validation reads.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Zuora subscriptions exported to a workspace TSV
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with path (the written .tsv file in the operator's workspace), columns, row_count, and truncated (true when row_count hit the effective limit -- more subscriptions may exist).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the listing: the written path, the row_count, and the column list. The file reflects sensitive billing content (data_sensitivity 0.5) -- name the path for downstream use but do not inline its contents. If truncated is true, warn that the listing hit the effective limit and point to a higher acknowledged row_limit (up to 5000) if more is needed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List a Zuora account's subscriptions and write the result to a tab-separated file in the operator's workspace, up to an acknowledged override ceiling.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params: missing account_id/output_tsv_path, the path's parent directory does not exist, acknowledge_default_limit_override and row_limit were not given together, or row_limit exceeded the 5000 hard cap. zuora.export_path_refused: the path is not absolute, not a .tsv, or not contained under any operator-configured export_allowed_roots entry (an empty export_allowed_roots refuses every export by default). zuora.object_not_found: no account with that id exists. zuora.auth_failed: the OAuth client credentials were rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: zuora.invalid_params naming the override pair: pass BOTH acknowledge_default_limit_override=true and an explicit row_limit, or neither (for the 500-record default); a row_limit above 5000 is refused outright, not clamped. zuora.export_path_refused: pass an ABSOLUTE path ending in .tsv under a configured workspace root; if export_allowed_roots is empty, add the operator's export directory to the zuora_plugin config and reload the plugin config. zuora.object_not_found: verify the account_id via data_query or get_object.
